title.zh: 给三条旧边编号并定义展开映射
title.en: Label the three old edges and define the extension

given.zh: $v$ 恰有三条关联边，可选标签 $c$，使每个 $i \in \{0, 1, 2\}$ 对应唯一一条 $e_i$。
given.en: Exactly three edges meet $v$, so choose labels $c$ with a unique incident edge $e_i$ for each $i \in \{0, 1, 2\}$.

claim.zh: 把旧边 $e_i$ 接到三角形顶点 $i$，定义 $f(x)$ 的旧边坐标仍为 $x(e)$，新边 $i$ 的坐标为 $x(e_i)$。$f$ 是线性映射。
claim.en: Attach old edge $e_i$ to tip $i$. Set $f(x)(\mathrm{old}\ e) = x(e)$ and $f(x)(\mathrm{new}\ i) = x(e_i)$. This defines a linear map.

statement.zh: 把关联边集合与 $\{0, 1, 2\}$ 配成双射，记 $c(e_i) = i$。
statement.en: Match the incident-edge set bijectively with $\{0, 1, 2\}$, writing $c(e_i) = i$.

reason.zh: 关联边恰有三条，因此每个标签既有对应边，又不会对应两条边。
reason.en: There are exactly three incident edges, so every label has exactly one corresponding edge.

statement.zh: $f(x)(\mathrm{old}\ e) = x(e)$，$f(x)(\mathrm{new}\ i) = x(e_i)$。
statement.en: $f(x)(\mathrm{old}\ e) = x(e)$, and $f(x)(\mathrm{new}\ i) = x(e_i)$.

reason.zh: 新边 $i$ 连接另外两个顶点；旧边 $e_i$ 选中时，复制它的坐标使对面的新边同时选中。
reason.en: New edge $i$ joins the other two tips. Copying the coordinate of $e_i$ selects that opposite edge whenever $e_i$ is selected.

statement.zh: $f(ax + by)(\mathrm{old}\ e) = a \cdot x(e) + b \cdot y(e)$，新边坐标同样成立。
statement.en: $f(ax + by)(\mathrm{old}\ e) = a \cdot x(e) + b \cdot y(e)$, with the same identity on new-edge coordinates.

reason.zh: 每个输出坐标都只读取一个输入坐标，所以加法与数乘可以逐坐标移到 $f$ 外。
reason.en: Each output coordinate reads just one input coordinate, so addition and scalar multiplication commute with $f$ coordinate by coordinate.

title.zh: 割质量只计算重新接入的旧边
title.en: Only reattached old edges contribute to the cut

given.zh: $T$ 是三角形的三个顶点，$L(y)$ 是一端在 $T$、一端在外的边的坐标总和。
given.en: $T$ consists of the three triangle tips; $L(y)$ sums coordinates of edges with exactly one endpoint in $T$.

claim.zh: $L(y) = \sum_{e \ni v} y(\mathrm{old}\ e)$。对完美匹配 $M$ 的指示向量 $\mathbf{1}_M$，这正是 $M$ 使用的跨割旧边数量 $k$。
claim.en: $L(y) = \sum_{e \ni v} y(\mathrm{old}\ e)$. For a perfect-matching indicator $\mathbf{1}_M$, this equals the number $k$ of old matching edges crossing the cut.

statement.zh: $\mathrm{new}\ i$ 的两端都在 $T$ 中，所以 $\mathrm{new}\ i \notin \delta(T)$。
statement.en: Both endpoints of $\mathrm{new}\ i$ lie in $T$, so $\mathrm{new}\ i \notin \delta(T)$.

reason.zh: 割 $\delta(T)$ 只保留恰有一个端点属于 $T$ 的边，三角形内部边不满足这个条件。
reason.en: The cut $\delta(T)$ contains edges with exactly one endpoint in $T$, which excludes internal triangle edges.

statement.zh: $\mathrm{old}\ e \in \delta(T) \iff e$ 关联原顶点 $v$。
statement.en: $\mathrm{old}\ e \in \delta(T)$ if and only if $e$ was incident to $v$.

reason.zh: 关联 $v$ 的旧边只有 $v$ 端被接入 $T$；无自环保证另一端在 $T$ 外。不关联 $v$ 的旧边两端都留在外面。
reason.en: Only the endpoint $v$ is reattached into $T$. Looplessness keeps the other endpoint outside; old edges not incident to $v$ remain entirely outside.

statement.zh: $L(y) = \sum_{e \ni v} y(\mathrm{old}\ e)$；$L(\mathbf{1}_M) = \sum_{e \ni v} 1_{\{\mathrm{old}\ e \in M\}} = k$。
statement.en: $L(y) = \sum_{e \ni v} y(\mathrm{old}\ e)$; $L(\mathbf{1}_M) = \sum_{e \ni v} 1_{\{\mathrm{old}\ e \in M\}} = k$.

reason.zh: 先按割中的边重写求和，再对指示向量把每个坐标读成零或一，就把线性泛函变成了边数。
reason.en: Rewrite the sum over cut edges, then read indicator coordinates as zero or one to turn the linear functional into an edge count.

title.zh: 三个顶点只允许两种局部匹配方式
title.en: The three tips allow only two local matching patterns

given.zh: $M$ 是 $H$ 的完美匹配，$k$ 是它选中的跨割旧边数，$t$ 是选中的三角形内部边数。这里讨论的是匹配指示向量。
given.en: Let $M$ be a perfect matching of $H$, with $k$ selected crossing old edges and $t$ selected internal triangle edges. At this step we consider matching indicators.

claim.zh: 每个三角形顶点恰被覆盖一次，所以 $k + 2t = 3$；任意两条三角形边共享顶点，所以 $t \le 1$。因此 $(k, t)$ 只能是 $(1, 1)$ 或 $(3, 0)$，$L(\mathbf{1}_M) \in \{1, 3\}$。
claim.en: Each tip is covered exactly once, so $k + 2t = 3$. Any two triangle edges share a tip, so $t \le 1$. Hence $(k, t)$ is either $(1, 1)$ or $(3, 0)$, and $L(\mathbf{1}_M) \in \{1, 3\}$.

statement.zh: 三角形三个顶点的覆盖次数之和为 $3$。
statement.en: The sum of matching-cover incidences at the three tips is $3$.

reason.zh: 完美匹配要求每个顶点恰被一条选中边覆盖，三个顶点各贡献一次。
reason.en: A perfect matching covers each tip by exactly one selected edge, contributing one incidence per tip.

statement.zh: 跨割边各贡献 $1$，内部边各贡献 $2$，所以 $k + 2t = 3$。
statement.en: A crossing edge contributes $1$ incidence and an internal edge contributes $2$, so $k + 2t = 3$.

reason.zh: 这里只统计边在 $T$ 内覆盖的端点数，外部顶点的覆盖不计入这条等式。
reason.en: Count only covered endpoints inside $T$; incidences at outside vertices do not enter this identity.

statement.zh: 任意两条三角形边相交，故 $t \in \{0, 1\}$；代入得到 $(k, t) = (3, 0)$ 或 $(1, 1)$。
statement.en: Any two triangle edges intersect, so $t \in \{0, 1\}$; substitution gives $(k, t) = (3, 0)$ or $(1, 1)$.

reason.zh: 匹配不允许两条选中边共用顶点，因此不能选中两条内部边。这列出允许的局部模式，不保证每幅 $G$ 都实现两种模式。
reason.en: A matching cannot select two edges sharing a tip. These are the allowed local patterns, without asserting that both occur for every $G$.

statement.zh: 每个匹配生成元都有 $L(\mathbf{1}_M) \ge 1$；此处尚未把取值限制推广到整个凸包。
statement.en: Every matching generator satisfies $L(\mathbf{1}_M) \ge 1$; the two-value restriction has not been extended to the convex hull.

reason.zh: 上一步 $L(\mathbf{1}_M) = k$。凸组合可以产生介于一和三之间的质量，后面只继承统一下界。
reason.en: The preceding identity gives $L(\mathbf{1}_M) = k$. Convex combinations may have intermediate masses, so only the common lower bound will pass to the whole polytope.

title.zh: 质量为一的匹配恰好来自原图
title.en: Mass-one matching generators come exactly from the old graph

given.zh: 原图匹配 $N$ 在 $v$ 处恰选一条 $e_i$；反过来，若 $H$ 的匹配 $M$ 有 $L(\mathbf{1}_M) = 1$，则它在 $T$ 处恰选一条旧边。
given.en: An old matching $N$ uses exactly one edge $e_i$ at $v$. Conversely, an expanded matching $M$ with $L(\mathbf{1}_M) = 1$ uses exactly one old edge at the triangle.

claim.zh: $N$ 展开成 $N$ 的全部旧边加新边 $i$，其指示向量等于 $f(\mathbf{1}_N)$。质量为一的 $M$ 去掉内部边后是 $G$ 的完美匹配，并且 $\mathbf{1}_M = f(\mathbf{1}_{\mathrm{oldPart}(M)})$。
claim.en: Expand $N$ by retaining its old edges and adding new edge $i$; its indicator is $f(\mathbf{1}_N)$. Removing the internal edge from a mass-one $M$ gives a perfect matching of $G$, and $\mathbf{1}_M = f(\mathbf{1}_{\mathrm{oldPart}(M)})$.

statement.zh: 若 $N$ 在 $v$ 处选中 $e_i$，则令 $M = \{\mathrm{old}\ e : e \in N\} \cup \{\mathrm{new}\ i\}$。
statement.en: If $N$ selects $e_i$ at $v$, set $M = \{\mathrm{old}\ e : e \in N\} \cup \{\mathrm{new}\ i\}$.

reason.zh: $e_i$ 在展开图中覆盖顶点 $i$，新边 $i$ 覆盖另两个顶点；三角形外的匹配边保持原样。
reason.en: The reattached $e_i$ covers tip $i$ and new edge $i$ covers the other two tips, while all outside matching edges remain unchanged.

statement.zh: $\mathbf{1}_M(\mathrm{old}\ e) = \mathbf{1}_N(e)$，$\mathbf{1}_M(\mathrm{new}\ j) = \mathbf{1}_N(e_j)$，故 $\mathbf{1}_M = f(\mathbf{1}_N)$。
statement.en: $\mathbf{1}_M(\mathrm{old}\ e) = \mathbf{1}_N(e)$ and $\mathbf{1}_M(\mathrm{new}\ j) = \mathbf{1}_N(e_j)$, hence $\mathbf{1}_M = f(\mathbf{1}_N)$.

reason.zh: 原匹配在 $v$ 处只选 $e_i$，因此新边等式两侧都恰在 $j = i$ 时取一。
reason.en: The old matching selects only $e_i$ at $v$, so the new-edge coordinate formula is one exactly when $j = i$.

statement.zh: 若 $L(\mathbf{1}_M) = 1$，则 $k = 1$、$t = 1$；把 $T$ 收缩回 $v$ 后，$\mathrm{oldPart}(M)$ 在 $v$ 处恰覆盖一次。
statement.en: If $L(\mathbf{1}_M) = 1$, then $k = t = 1$; collapsing $T$ back to $v$ makes $\mathrm{oldPart}(M)$ cover $v$ exactly once.

reason.zh: 唯一跨割边负责覆盖收缩后的 $v$；三角形外的每个顶点仍由原先那条旧边恰好覆盖一次。
reason.en: The unique crossing edge covers the collapsed $v$, and each outside vertex remains covered by its unique old matching edge.

statement.zh: 唯一跨割边是 $\mathrm{old}\ e_i$ 时，内部边只能是 $\mathrm{new}\ i$，因此 $\mathbf{1}_M = f(\mathbf{1}_{\mathrm{oldPart}(M)})$。
statement.en: When the unique crossing edge is $\mathrm{old}\ e_i$, the internal edge must be $\mathrm{new}\ i$, giving $\mathbf{1}_M = f(\mathbf{1}_{\mathrm{oldPart}(M)})$.

reason.zh: 顶点 $i$ 已被跨割边覆盖，内部边只能连接另外两个顶点；这排除了反向还原中多选或漏选新边的可能。
reason.en: Tip $i$ is already covered by the crossing edge, so the internal edge must join the remaining tips. This uniquely determines the new-edge coordinates in the inverse construction.

title.zh: 凸组合达到质量一时只能使用质量一的生成元
title.en: A mass-one convex combination only uses mass-one generators

given.zh: 任取 $y = \sum_j w_j s_j \in R$，其中 $s_j$ 是匹配指示向量、$w_j \ge 0$、$\sum_j w_j = 1$，并假设 $L(y) = 1$。
given.en: Take $y = \sum_j w_j s_j \in R$, with matching indicators $s_j$, weights $w_j \ge 0$ and $\sum_j w_j = 1$, and assume $L(y) = 1$.

claim.zh: 所有正权项都满足 $L(s_j) = 1$，故 $Q = R \cap \{L = 1\} = \mathrm{conv}\{s \in \text{gen} : L(s) = 1\} = f(P)$。一般 $y \in R$ 的割质量可取中间值，并不局限于一或三。
claim.en: Every positive-weight term satisfies $L(s_j) = 1$. Hence $Q = R \cap \{L = 1\} = \mathrm{conv}\{\text{generators } s : L(s) = 1\} = f(P)$. A general point of $R$ may have an intermediate cut mass, rather than only one or three.

statement.zh: $L(y) - 1 = \sum_j w_j L(s_j) - \sum_j w_j = \sum_j w_j(L(s_j) - 1)$。
statement.en: $L(y) - 1 = \sum_j w_j L(s_j) - \sum_j w_j = \sum_j w_j(L(s_j) - 1)$.

reason.zh: 把 $y$ 的凸组合代入线性泛函，并使用权重和为一；差值被写成每个生成元超出下界的加权总量。
reason.en: Apply the linear functional to the convex combination and use the unit weight sum. The difference becomes the weighted total excess above the lower bound.

statement.zh: $L(y) = 1$ 时，$\sum_j w_j(L(s_j) - 1) = 0$，且每一项均非负。
statement.en: If $L(y) = 1$, the sum $\sum_j w_j(L(s_j) - 1)$ is zero and every summand is nonnegative.

reason.zh: $w_j \ge 0$ 来自凸组合，$L(s_j) - 1 \ge 0$ 来自匹配生成元的计数下界，因此不存在正负相抵。
reason.en: The weights are nonnegative and the matching count gives $L(s_j) - 1 \ge 0$, so cancellation between positive and negative terms is impossible.

statement.zh: $w_j > 0 \implies L(s_j) = 1$；删去零权项后，$y$ 仍是质量一生成元的凸组合。
statement.en: $w_j > 0$ implies $L(s_j) = 1$. Removing zero-weight terms leaves $y$ as a convex combination of mass-one generators.

reason.zh: 非负有限和为零使每一项为零；正权重可以约去。删掉的项既不改变向量和，也不改变权重和。
reason.en: Every term in a zero nonnegative finite sum vanishes, and a positive weight can be cancelled. Removing zero-weight terms preserves both the vector sum and total weight.

statement.zh: $Q = \mathrm{conv}\{f(\mathbf{1}_N) : N \in \mathcal{M}(G)\} = f(\mathrm{conv}\{\mathbf{1}_N\}) = f(P)$。
statement.en: $Q = \mathrm{conv}\{f(\mathbf{1}_N) : N \text{ is a matching of } G\} = f(\mathrm{conv}\{\mathbf{1}_N\}) = f(P)$.

reason.zh: 用前一步的生成元双向对应替换集合，再用 $f(\sum w_j x_j) = \sum w_j f(x_j)$ 把 $f$ 移出凸包。
reason.en: Replace the generators using the preceding two-way correspondence, then commute $f$ with each convex combination to move it outside the convex hull.

title.zh: 达到线性下界的截面是一个面
title.en: The section attaining the linear lower bound is a face

given.zh: $R$ 是凸包，故为凸集；所有 $y \in R$ 都满足 $L(y) \ge 1$，$Q = R \cap \{L = 1\}$。
given.en: $R$ is a convex hull and thus convex. Every $y \in R$ satisfies $L(y) \ge 1$, and $Q = R \cap \{L = 1\}$.

claim.zh: $Q$ 为凸集，并且当 $z = \alpha x + \beta y \in Q$、$x, y \in R$、$\alpha, \beta > 0$、$\alpha + \beta = 1$ 时，必有 $x, y \in Q$。
claim.en: $Q$ is convex. If $z = \alpha x + \beta y \in Q$ with $x, y \in R$, $\alpha, \beta > 0$ and $\alpha + \beta = 1$, then $x, y \in Q$.

statement.zh: 若 $y = \sum_j w_j s_j \in R$，则 $L(y) = \sum_j w_j L(s_j) \ge \sum_j w_j = 1$。
statement.en: For $y = \sum_j w_j s_j \in R$, $L(y) = \sum_j w_j L(s_j) \ge \sum_j w_j = 1$.

reason.zh: 每个生成元的下界由非负权重保留下来，这里得到的是整个 $R$ 上的下界。
reason.en: Nonnegative weights preserve the generator bound, giving the lower bound on all of $R$.

statement.zh: $z = \alpha x + \beta y \in Q \implies \alpha(L(x) - 1) + \beta(L(y) - 1) = 0$。
statement.en: If $z = \alpha x + \beta y \in Q$, then $\alpha(L(x) - 1) + \beta(L(y) - 1) = 0$.

reason.zh: 线性性给出 $L(z) = \alpha L(x) + \beta L(y) = 1$，再减去 $\alpha + \beta = 1$。两项都非负。
reason.en: Linearity gives $L(z) = \alpha L(x) + \beta L(y) = 1$; subtract $\alpha + \beta = 1$. Both resulting terms are nonnegative.

statement.zh: $\alpha, \beta > 0 \implies L(x) = L(y) = 1$；再结合 $Q = R \cap \{L = 1\}$ 的凸性，得到 $Q$ 是 $R$ 的面。
statement.en: Since $\alpha, \beta > 0$, $L(x) = L(y) = 1$. Together with convexity of $Q = R \cap \{L = 1\}$, this makes $Q$ a face of $R$.

reason.zh: 非负两项和为零使二者同时为零。这样内部点落在 $Q$ 的线段，其两个端点也必须落在 $Q$。
reason.en: A zero sum of two nonnegative terms forces both to vanish. Thus whenever an interior point of a segment in $R$ lies in $Q$, both endpoints lie in $Q$ as well.

title.zh: 旧边限制给出展开映射的逆
title.en: Restriction to old edges inverts the extension

given.zh: $g$ 只保留旧边坐标，$f$ 在旧边上原样复制；同时已经知道 $Q = f(P)$。
given.en: The map $g$ retains old-edge coordinates, $f$ copies those coordinates unchanged, and $Q = f(P)$.

claim.zh: 对所有 $x$ 有 $g(f(x)) = x$；对 $y \in Q$ 有 $f(g(y)) = y$。因而 $f : P \to Q$ 是线性同构，且对常量向量 $x \equiv 1/3$ 有 $f(x) \equiv 1/3$。
claim.en: For every $x$, $g(f(x)) = x$; for $y \in Q$, $f(g(y)) = y$. Thus $f : P \to Q$ is a linear isomorphism, and a constant vector $x \equiv 1/3$ is sent to $f(x) \equiv 1/3$.

statement.zh: $g(f(x))(e) = f(x)(\mathrm{old}\ e) = x(e)$，所以 $g \circ f = \mathrm{id}$。
statement.en: $g(f(x))(e) = f(x)(\mathrm{old}\ e) = x(e)$, so $g \circ f = \mathrm{id}$.

reason.zh: $g$ 的定义就是读取旧边坐标，$f$ 在这些坐标上没有改变输入。
reason.en: By definition $g$ reads old-edge coordinates, and $f$ leaves those coordinates unchanged.

statement.zh: $f(x) = f(x') \implies x = g(f(x)) = g(f(x')) = x'$。
statement.en: If $f(x) = f(x')$, then $x = g(f(x)) = g(f(x')) = x'$.

reason.zh: 在两边应用 $g$，把输出相等还原成输入相等，因此 $f$ 单射。
reason.en: Applying $g$ to both sides recovers equality of the inputs, proving injectivity of $f$.

statement.zh: $y \in Q = f(P) \implies y = f(x) \implies f(g(y)) = f(g(f(x))) = f(x) = y$。
statement.en: If $y \in Q = f(P)$, write $y = f(x)$; then $f(g(y)) = f(g(f(x))) = f(x) = y$.

reason.zh: 像的等式提供 $x \in P$；中间的 $g(f(x))$ 再用第一行消去。第二个逆等式只在 $Q$ 上使用。
reason.en: The image equality supplies $x \in P$, and the first identity removes $g(f(x))$. This second inverse identity is used only on $Q$.

statement.zh: 若 $x(e) = 1/3$ 对所有旧边成立，则 $f(x)(\mathrm{old}\ e) = f(x)(\mathrm{new}\ i) = 1/3$。
statement.en: If $x(e) = 1/3$ on all old edges, then $f(x)(\mathrm{old}\ e) = f(x)(\mathrm{new}\ i) = 1/3$.

reason.zh: 新边 $i$ 复制的是旧边 $e_i$ 的坐标，所以常量向量在全部展开坐标上仍然保持常量。
reason.en: The new edge $i$ copies the coordinate of $e_i$, so all expanded coordinates retain the same constant value.

title.zh: 最小面随线性同构一起传递
title.en: The linear isomorphism transports minimal faces

given.zh: $x \in P$，$Q = f(P)$ 是 $R$ 的面，$g \circ f = \mathrm{id}$，$f \circ g$ 在 $Q$ 上为恒等映射；$\mathrm{minFace}$ 是所有经过该点的凸面的交。
given.en: Let $x \in P$. The image $Q = f(P)$ is a face of $R$, $g \circ f = \mathrm{id}$, and $f \circ g$ is the identity on $Q$. The minimal face is the intersection of all convex faces through the point.

claim.zh: $\mathrm{minFace}(R, f(x)) = f(\mathrm{minFace}(P, x))$，完成原题关于匹配多面体、逆映射、三分之一向量和最小面的全部结论。
claim.en: $\mathrm{minFace}(R, f(x)) = f(\mathrm{minFace}(P, x))$, completing the stated conclusions about the polytope image, inverse maps, the one-third vector and minimal faces.

statement.zh: $f(x) \in Q$ 且 $Q$ 是 $R$ 的面，因此 $\mathrm{minFace}(R, f(x)) \subseteq Q$。
statement.en: Since $f(x) \in Q$ and $Q$ is a face of $R$, $\mathrm{minFace}(R, f(x)) \subseteq Q$.

reason.zh: 最小面是所有经过该点的凸面的交；$Q$ 正是可以参与这个交的一个面。
reason.en: The minimal face is the intersection of convex faces through the point, and $Q$ is one of those faces.

statement.zh: 对 $F \subseteq Q$，$F$ 是 $R$ 的面 $\iff F$ 是 $Q$ 的面。
statement.en: For $F \subseteq Q$, $F$ is a face of $R$ if and only if it is a face of $Q$.

reason.zh: 一个方向直接限制环境；另一个方向先用 $Q$ 的面性质把线段端点留在 $Q$，再用 $F$ 的面性质。
reason.en: One direction restricts the ambient set. For the other, the face property of $Q$ first places segment endpoints in $Q$, and the face property of $F$ then applies.

statement.zh: 对 $S \subseteq P$，$S$ 是 $P$ 的面 $\iff f(S)$ 是 $Q$ 的面，且凸性也由 $f$、$g$ 双向保持。
statement.en: For $S \subseteq P$, $S$ is a face of $P$ if and only if $f(S)$ is a face of $Q$; $f$ and $g$ also preserve convexity in both directions.

reason.zh: 把开线段等式在 $f$、$g$ 下传递。$g \circ f = \mathrm{id}$ 与 $Q$ 上 $f \circ g = \mathrm{id}$ 确保端点和内部点都能还原。
reason.en: Transport each open-segment identity through $f$ and $g$. Their inverse identities recover both endpoints and interior points, so no face condition is lost.

statement.zh: $\mathrm{minFace}(R, f(x)) = \mathrm{minFace}(Q, f(x)) = f(\mathrm{minFace}(P, x))$。
statement.en: $\mathrm{minFace}(R, f(x)) = \mathrm{minFace}(Q, f(x)) = f(\mathrm{minFace}(P, x))$.

reason.zh: 第一行把 $R$ 的最小面限制在 $Q$ 内，第二行识别两种环境下的面，第三行把所有经过指定点的面一一对应后取交。
reason.en: The first line confines the minimal face to $Q$, the second identifies the ambient face conditions, and the third pairs all faces through the chosen point before taking their intersection.
